briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Window:** roughly 16 Oct to 15 Nov 2026, based on the latest dated source in the results.

## Summary
Zepto's recent coverage centres on festive demand, a brand campaign, and a viral employee-pay controversy. The results contain no confirmed hires or deals in the window.

## Last 30 Days

**News and public perception**
- A viral video about Zepto's Diwali bonus, in which a delivery partner reportedly received "cash-like coupons" instead of money, drew criticism of working conditions in India's startup and gig economy. A user post from 7 Nov also referenced Zepto's valuation and employee bonus. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Launches and campaigns**
- Zepto ran a brand campaign it describes as "landing in Seoul Street," with Anime India next. Zepto's chief brand officer, Chandan Mendiratta, is quoted, and Zepto has not said which fandom comes next. Fans were due to queue in Hyderabad on 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

**Operations and demand**
- During Dhanteras and Diwali 2026, Zepto reported strong festive orders for gold, silver, and household goods. Its headline claim is over 14,000 gold and silver coins delivered in one hour. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)

**People and HR**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora is quoted. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)

**Sector context (not Zepto-specific)**
- Grocery is expected to overtake mobile phones as the second-largest category in India's online retail market, behind fashion. Zepto appears only in the article's related-topic tags. (https://www.business-standard.com/industry/news/grocery-to-overtake-mobiles-as-india-s-online-retail-market-to-cross-90-bn-126102000451_1.html)

**Hires and deals:** No sources in the results report a new hire or deal in the window.

## Background (outside the window, unverified)
- A company database profile lists a venture round of USD 100M dated 1 July 2026, and a Series H of USD 450M dated 16 Nov 2025. The profile is undated and self-described as a database entry, so verify before citing. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

## Open questions
1. What is the structure of the Diwali bonus for delivery partners versus office employees, and will Zepto change the coupon-based payout in response to the viral criticism?
2. Following the July 2026 funding round and the reported valuation, what are Zepto's near-term plans for capital, expansion, or a future listing?
3. What are the next steps for the Anime India campaign, and how is Zepto measuring the return on its brand spend?
